text: The localizer transmitter is situated on the extended runway centerline beyond the stop end. The localizer beam normally defines the centerline of the runway and extends along the approach path for 25 miles with 40 ILS channels within the frequency range of 108.10 to 111.95 MHz to provide pilots with course guidance.
